instruction: Use the opened OpenStudio application and its CLI/API automation interface to organize /home/user/Desktop/init.osm and save the updated model as /home/user/Desktop/result.osm. Do not directly create, rewrite, patch, copy, or post-process OSM text outside the OpenStudio environment. The current model is a corner retail shop with a restroom. The south and west sides carry the main display role, while the restroom on the east side needs only a smaller opening. The operator wants the model to support water and electricity end-use tracking. In addition to organizing sales and restroom loads, include restroom sink water use, entry exterior lighting, and key reporting requests. Do not change the exterior outline or room organization. Deliver only the updated OpenStudio model file; object handles, serialization order, and automatically generated metadata may vary naturally.
